comments.author: @JayLeePeace2026
comments.text:
Putting money into a Cheaper Rifle is absolutely OKAY to do... You get the Parts you actually want and make it into a Gucci gun $1 at a time instead of dumping $2500 into a Brand Name all at 1 time.... Unless you have the funding to do, which many of us do not. 
I've turned a $700 DB into a fantastic Range/Duty/Vehicle/Bugout Rifle that does Everything a DD will do. 
Why not put some money into that firearm? Make it reliable and controllable for Peanuts. 
The hell with Big Names ... They Lobby against us to keep prices higher on things.
